title: 1.3 Two People: y and ellos
unit_outcome: Understand and say short Spanish sentences about people, family members, and what they are doing.
goal: Join two people with y, replace them with ellos, and use están with running, sitting, swimming, and sleeping.
grammar_function: Person y person + están + action; Ellos están + action; está/están sentado(s).
prerequisite: Spanish 1.1-1.2: the four people, el/la, es, and está + action.
speaking_outcome: Say what one or two people are doing.

cards.pedagogy_note: y joins two people; each keeps its article.

cards.pedagogy_note: ellos: a boy and a girl together take the masculine plural.
corriendo: they are running.
está sentado: sitting uses sentado, not an -ando form.
nadando: he is swimming.
durmiendo: she is sleeping.
